Whether you are navigating tight trails or busy city streets, you'll do so with total confidence.Built to Stand OutFrom the aggressive wide-body stance to the functional front fog lights and signature Raptor styling, this truck makes its presence known immediately. Every detail of the Equipment Group 801A has been refined to offer the best of Fords engineering. Its more than just a pickup, its a sophisticated, go-anywhere machine that refuses to compromise. Visit us to experience why the F-150 Raptor remains the most sought-after name in the world of high-performance trucks.Faster. Simpler. More Transparent. Finished in stunning Avalanche and powered by the legendary 3.5L EcoBoost V6 paired to Ford’s advanced 10-speed automatic transmission, this Gold Certified F-150 delivers the premium ownership experience truck buyers demand while still maintaining the rugged capability that has made the F-Series America’s best-selling truck for decades.

With only 35,958 miles, this Gold Certified Platinum has already proven itself while still offering tremendous long-term value and confidence. Gold Certified status means this truck has passed a rigorous Ford inspection process and includes additional factory-backed benefits that help provide peace of mind for the next owner. Coverage includes a comprehensive limited warranty, powertrain limited warranty coverage, 24/7 roadside assistance, rental car benefits, and FordPass Rewards points, making ownership even more rewarding.

The Platinum trim represents the top tier of F-150 luxury and refinement. Inside, the cabin is loaded with premium black leather seating surfaces, heated and ventilated front seats, heated second-row seating, memory driver functions, power-adjustable pedals with memory, a heated leather-wrapped steering wheel, ambient lighting, and a power tilt/telescoping steering column. The spacious SuperCrew configuration provides outstanding rear seat room for passengers while still maintaining the utility and flexibility expected from a full-size pickup.

Technology is everywhere in this F-150 Platinum. The massive 12-inch productivity screen and SYNC 4 infotainment system with enhanced voice recognition provide seamless access to navigation, media, smartphone connectivity, and vehicle controls. FordPass Connect with 5G WiFi hotspot capability keeps passengers connected on the go while intelligent access with push-button start adds everyday convenience. The Mobile Office Package transforms the truck into a functional workspace perfect for contractors, business owners, and professionals constantly on the move throughout Tampa Bay and beyond.

Capability remains a core strength of this truck. Equipped with the FX4 Off-Road Package, this F-150 is ready for everything from job sites to weekend adventures. Features include skid plates, all-terrain tires, electronic locking rear axle, and off-road-tuned capability that gives this Platinum real-world versatility beyond its luxury appointments. The extended-range 36-gallon fuel tank helps maximize driving range for long road trips, towing, or heavy-duty use around Florida and beyond.

Additional premium exterior features include power-deployable running boards, LED projector headlamps with dynamic bending technology, LED fog lamps, LED side mirror spotlights, power sliding rear window, remote tailgate release, wheel well liners, and striking 20-inch painted gloss ebony black wheels that perfectly complement the Avalanche exterior finish.

Ford’s advanced safety and driver-assistance technology is heavily represented as well. This Platinum includes BLIS with Cross Traffic Alert, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping system, reverse brake assist, reverse sensing system, 360-degree camera system, post-collision braking, rear view camera, AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, and Ford’s BlueCruise equipment package with a 90-day trial included. These systems work together to create an incredibly confident and modern driving experience whether commuting through Wesley Chapel traffic, towing along I-75, or heading across the state for a weekend getaway.

This 2013 Ford Mustang GT Roush Stage 3 is the perfect combination of modern muscle, track-inspired engineering, and aggressive styling. Finished in sleek black over a matching black interior, this Mustang delivers an intimidating presence that perfectly reflects the performance underneath. With only 21,729 original miles, this low-mileage example offers an outstanding opportunity to own one of the most respected and sought-after specialty Mustangs of the modern era.

At the heart of this Stage 3 sits Ford's legendary 5.0L Coyote V8, upgraded by Roush with a high-performance supercharger system that pushed output to an impressive 565 horsepower from the factory. Paired with a 6-speed manual transmission, this Mustang delivers a raw and engaging driving experience that enthusiasts crave. The combination of instant throttle response, supercharged power delivery, and manual gear changes creates the kind of excitement that defines true American performance cars.

The Roush Stage 3 package transformed the standard Mustang GT into a far more capable performance machine. Upgrades included a race-inspired suspension system, performance exhaust, aerodynamic body enhancements, and unique Roush styling elements that set it apart from ordinary Mustangs. From the aggressive front fascia and rear spoiler to the signature graphics and badging, every detail was designed to enhance both appearance and performance.

Inside, the black interior offers a clean, driver-focused cockpit with modern comfort and technology. Supportive sport seating, premium materials, and classic Mustang styling cues make the cabin both comfortable and performance-oriented. The 2013 model year also benefited from updated interior technology and styling improvements, making it one of the most refined versions of the S197 generation.

Roush-built Mustangs have long been respected for their balance of factory-backed reliability and aftermarket-level performance. The Stage 3 models, in particular, are considered the flagship of the lineup and remain highly desirable among collectors and enthusiasts. Low-mileage, well-kept examples like this continue to gain attention as modern muscle cars become increasingly collectible.

Whether you're looking for a thrilling weekend car, a standout showpiece, or an investment-grade modern muscle car, this 2013 Roush Stage 3 Mustang delivers supercharged performance, unmistakable styling, and legendary V8 power in one unforgettable package.
